recipe.accepted: base; cam-b via with_camera(camera-override fall 0.7 rev 2/3, facility-default bed_exit 0.5/10/5 rev 2); no cameras; fall threshold sent as integer 1 with the oracle identity over 1.0
recipe.refused: one mutation of a deep copy of base per case, named by the case

review.note: Each case is one detection_policies value of a worker-config response. accepted is parse_policy_bundle's verdict (refused means PolicyDocumentError, so pull_models raises WorkerConfigError, keeps the LKG and the poll yields nothing). canonical_json is _canonical_json(parsed.as_dict()) and content_sha256 its sha256. inject names a non-finite float ('inf' or 'nan') placed at inject_path in memory before the oracle runs: JSON text cannot carry it with allow_nan=False, and the Rust parse_json refuses NaN/Infinity text earlier.
